title: Surjectivity of Gaussian torus pullback
statement: Let $n\ge0$, let $\mu$ be any measure on $\mathbb R^n$, let $\mathbb K$ be either $\mathbb R$ or $\mathbb C$, and let $p\in[1,\infty]$. Define $T:\mathbb R^n\to(\mathbb R/\mathbb Z)^{\{1,\ldots,n\}\times\{0,1\}}$ by $T(x)_{i,0}=x_i\pmod{\mathbb Z}$ and $T(x)_{i,1}=\sqrt2\,x_i\pmod{\mathbb Z}$. The pullback map $f\mapsto f\circ T$ from $L^p(T_\#\mu)$ to $L^p(\mu)$ is surjective.
hypotheses_covered: Scalar field $\mathbb K=\mathbb R$ or $\mathbb C$
